whatIsSection.title: What Is a UAE Dependent Visa?
paragraphs: A UAE Dependent Residence Visa allows UAE residence visa holders to sponsor their family members — spouse, children, parents, and domestic workers — to live with them in the UAE.

If you hold an employment or investor visa with a minimum salary of AED 4,000, you can sponsor your spouse and children under your residency. For parents, the requirement is AED 20,000+ with additional documents.

Dependent visa holders enjoy full residency rights — work permits, banking, healthcare, education, and Emirates ID. At Setup Zone Dubai, we handle the complete family sponsorship process from documentation to visa stamping.

items.q: Who can sponsor dependents in the UAE?
items.a: Any UAE residence visa holder with a valid employment or investor visa can sponsor dependents. Requirements include minimum salary (AED 4,000+ or AED 3,000 + accommodation), adequate housing, and health insurance.

items.q: What is the minimum salary to sponsor family?
items.a: For spouse and children: AED 4,000 monthly (or AED 3,000 + accommodation). For parents: typically AED 20,000 monthly salary with accommodation and insurance.

items.q: Can my spouse work in the UAE with a dependent visa?
items.a: Yes. Your spouse can apply for a work permit after obtaining the dependent visa. Many employers sponsor this change.

items.q: How long is a dependent visa valid?
items.a: Dependent visas are typically valid for 2-3 years, matching the sponsor's visa validity. They must be renewed along with the sponsor's visa.

items.q: Can I sponsor my parents in the UAE?
items.a: Yes. You can sponsor your parents (60+ years old) if you meet the minimum salary requirement (AED 20,000+ per month), provide adequate housing, and valid health insurance.

items.q: What documents need to be attested?
items.a: Marriage certificate (for spouse), birth certificates (for children), and educational certificates must be attested by the UAE Embassy in your home country and the MOFA in the UAE.

items.q: Can I sponsor my domestic worker?
items.a: Yes. You can sponsor domestic workers including housemaids, cooks, drivers, nannies, and gardeners under the domestic worker visa category.

items.q: How long does the dependent visa process take?
items.a: Typically 2-4 weeks depending on document readiness and processing times. We fast-track the process through our priority government network.

items.q: Can children study in the UAE with a dependent visa?
items.a: Yes. Children with dependent visas can enroll in UAE schools and universities. They need their Emirates ID and school-specific documentation.

items.q: Why choose Setup Zone Dubai for dependent visa services?
items.a: We provide end-to-end support — eligibility assessment, documentation, application filing, medicals, Emirates ID, and visa stamping. With a proven track record and direct authority access, we ensure fast, compliant processing.
